notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Ondu Spiritdancer.
description:
Kill Ondu Spiritdancer.
Myrkul triggers, creating a token copy of Ondu Spiritdancer that is an enchantment.
When the token Ondu Spiridancer enters the battlefield, it and Grim Guardian trigger.
Resolve the Grim Guardian trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Ondu Spiritdancer trigger, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat from step 3.
